title: Cabbage dumpling soup
subtitle: A comforting cabbage soup with mushrooms and dumpling filling.

ingredientGroups.heading: Soup:
items: 4 oz Mushrooms (about half a small pack)

directions: Slice and saute the mushrooms. Once browned, remove from pan and set aside.
Add chopped garlic and onions to hot pan. Cook for a few minutes.
Add 1 tsp red miso paste to soften onions. Stir until paste is well disolved.
Add chopped cabbage. Cover with water (about 2 cups, or just enough to cover the cabbage. Let it come to a boil.
Once boiling, scoop groud beef into teaspoon and drop in the hot soup. (No need to shape perfect round balls, just scoop and drop).
Cook the soup with dumpling filling for 10 mins, unitl ground meat is cooked through.
Prepare savory topping by chopping red radish, season with dash of vinegar and soy sauce.
Garnish soup with seasoned radish and green onions.
